name: Herb-Roasted Salmon with Potato, Spinach & Parmesan Fritters

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat salmon dry with paper towels. Place on the baking sheet, skin-side down, and sprinkle with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb salmon fillet
oregano, dried
salt
black pepper
¼ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, place both hash browns and spinach in a colander; rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the hash browns and spinach as you can. Place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
1 (16oz) bag frozen chopped spinach

instructions.primary_message: Add Parmesan, eggs, flour, and spices to the bowl with the hash browns and spinach. Stir to combine the potato mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
4 eggs
salt
oregano, dried
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches if necessary, using a ¼-cup measure, drop potato mixture into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
To serve, divide salmon and fritters between plates. Enjoy!
